decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY changing its standby_power_control from GPIO3 to GPIO5, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Changing the 5V boost-enable GPIO does not alter the DCDC1 3.3V rail voltage, rating, or load coverage.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the AXP2101 battery input or its role as the normal-operation power source.
The source changes 5V_EN control, not the charge-status signal, GPIO13 data interface, or dedicated charge-LED circuit.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not affect the battery connector family, pin count, functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not change battery protection thresholds, controller selection, or DW01A protection components.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment has no effect on the J_BAT NTC terminal or AXP2101 thermal-monitoring behavior.
The interboard connector continues to carry the logical 5V_EN signal on pin 7; changing the ESP32 GPIO behind that signal does not change the connector pinout.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording 5V_EN as GPIO5 together with the SCL0 and SPI MOSI reassignments, so no edit is needed.
The source changes control of the separate boosted 5V rail and does not alter the standalone USB-powered 3.3V supply or source-selection behavior.
The GPIO changes accommodate the already selected WROOM-1 module but do not change the module selection; its same-message module_variant Event requires no augmentation.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not change BOM completeness, sourcing data, approved components, or charge-LED assembly selections.
